title: English Practice Quiz 0954
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: A balanced diet includes a variety of ___.
questions.explanation: Variety helps provide a range of nutrients.

questions.question: Taking short movement breaks during long periods of sitting can help reduce ___.
questions.explanation: Brief movement breaks can ease prolonged static posture.

questions.question: Dehydration occurs when the body loses more fluid than it ___.
questions.explanation: Dehydration is a deficit of body fluids.

questions.question: Good hand hygiene helps reduce the spread of ___.
questions.explanation: Hand hygiene reduces transmission of many infectious agents.

questions.question: If a coworker feels unwell at work, you should ___.
options: encourage them to seek appropriate help and follow workplace procedure
questions.explanation: Appropriate support and established procedures protect the person and others.

questions.question: Ergonomics is concerned with designing work to fit ___.
questions.explanation: Ergonomics adapts tasks and environments to human capabilities.

questions.question: A good way to reduce eye strain when using a screen is to ___.
options: take regular breaks and look away from the screen
questions.explanation: Regular visual breaks can reduce digital eye strain.

questions.question: A healthy sleep routine usually benefits from ___.
options: heavy screen use in bed all night
drinking strong coffee just before sleep
questions.explanation: A regular sleep schedule supports healthy sleep habits.

questions.question: A workplace wellness programme may encourage ___.
questions.explanation: Wellness programmes often support health education and prevention.

questions.question: If you experience a sudden serious medical emergency, you should ___.
questions.explanation: Serious emergencies require prompt professional assistance.
